## Project Study pages

Before creating, editing or reviewing any Project Study page, read `docs/project-studies/README.md` completely and follow it as the canonical specification.

This applies to:

- `src/ProjectStudyPages/**`
- `src/components/studies/**`
- `src/data/projectStudies.*`
- Routes under `/development/`, `/design/`, `/construction/`, `/operations/` and `/exit/` that render a Project Study

Project Study pages must be data-driven, use verified project facts, distinguish personal responsibility from external contributions, and never invent evidence records, measurements, dates, costs or outcomes.

If a user prompt conflicts with the Project Study standard, follow the user’s explicit request but preserve factual accuracy and report the deviation.
